query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.status, m.isRescheduled,
       d.firstName, d.lastName, d.company,
       s.companyName AS sponsorCompany
FROM meetings m
JOIN delegateProfiles d ON m.attendeeId = d.id
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE (d.firstName LIKE '%Oliver%' AND d.lastName LIKE '%Brown%')
ORDER BY m.id;
